sensitivity_block.policy_variant: cache-enabled: 40% of T2 input at 10% of input price

rounding.notes: Applied at publication only; all intermediate arithmetic is full-precision decimal. basket_cost carries more decimal places than dated_siu so the published print is reproducible from its own published figures. siu_per_usd truncates so it never overstates the work a dollar buys.

correction_notes.note: A reasoning-token cost gap affected this print: gemini-3.1-pro-preview's reasoning tokens (RunRecord.usage.reasoning — real, captured in every run record for this print) were not priced. packages/print/src/compute/class-cost.ts computed cost from usage.output alone. Reasoning tokens are billed by the provider at the output rate — confirmed live, 2026-09-08: Google's own published pricing states "Output price (including thinking tokens)", and a separate live check (xAI's real per-call billed cost) independently confirmed the same billing convention for reasoning models generally. This is not a methodology refinement — the index measures realised cost from executed runs, and the run records already carried this field. Corrected figures, computed from this print's own real run records and price snapshot with the fix applied, not from new data: this print's dated_siu was originally reported as $0.0120; the corrected figure is $0.0132. gemini-3.1-pro-preview's own basket cost was originally reported as $0.014111; the corrected figure is $0.020371. This print itself is not recomputed or replaced — the original stands, per the revision policy's unconditional never-edit guarantee. The fix (packages/print/src/compute/class-cost.ts, cost-of-production.ts) applies forward from the next published print onward, which will show a real, one-time jump in gemini-3.1-pro-preview's cost for this methodological reason, not a market move — see docs/methodology.md's Index governance.

This print includes gemini-3.1-pro-preview, whose Google Cloud billing predates the point where it was isolated to this project alone. Before that, a real, unexplained cost gap was found between Google's actual billed Gemini cost and this project's own computed cost on every day independently checked (2026-09-08 through 2026-09-10 -- 2026-09-08 far larger than the others, but the gap wasn't confined to that one day). This project's own per-token pricing was independently verified against Google's real published rates and confirmed correct, ruling out a calculation error on this project's side -- but the cause of the gap itself was never established, and Gemini's own real invoice cost for any day before isolation cannot be attributed to this project with confidence. Because that evidence gap cannot be reconstructed after the fact, this print will remain status: "provisional" permanently, not through neglect. See docs/methodology.md's Index governance (§7) for the general policy and the isolation fix that resolves this for prints going forward.
